diffusion-stop:Max. timestamp.title: Max. timestamp
diffusion-stop:Max. timestamp.text:
The simulation stops a) when a certain timestamp is reached or b) when no more timestamps are available.

Parameters
^^^^^^^^^^
* :code:`max`: the maximum timestamp.

Configuration file
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code:: yaml
  
  stop:
    Max. timestamp:
      max:
        type: long
        value: maximum_timestamp
diffusion-stop:Max. timestamp.html:
The simulation stops a) when a certain timestamp is reached or b) when no more timestamps are available.

Parameters

  • max: the maximum timestamp.

diffusion-stop:No more new.title: No more new
diffusion-stop:No more new.text:
The simulation stops when no more new information is propagated (i.e. people might still propagate information, but
the recipients already know that information).

Configuration file
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code:: yaml
  
  stop:
    No more new:
diffusion-stop:No more new.html: The simulation stops when no more new information is propagated (i.e. people might still propagate information, but the recipients already know that information).

diffusion-stop:No more propagated.title: No more propagated
diffusion-stop:No more propagated.text:
The simulation stops when no information has been propagated during the last iteration.

Configuration file
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code:: yaml
  
  stop:
    No more propagated:
diffusion-stop:No more propagated.html: The simulation stops when no information has been propagated during the last iteration.

    No more timestamps:
diffusion-stop:No more timestamps.html: The simulation stops when no more timestamps are available.

diffusion-stop:No more timestamps nor pr.title: No more timestamps nor propagated information
diffusion-stop:No more timestamps nor pr.text:
The simulation stops when no more timestamps are available or when users are not propagating information to others.

Configuration file
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code:: yaml
  
  stop:
    No more timestamps nor propagated:
diffusion-stop:No more timestamps nor pr.html: The simulation stops when no more timestamps are available or when users are not propagating information to others.

diffusion-stop:Num. Iter.title: Num. Iter
diffusion-stop:Num. Iter.text:
The simulation stops when a fixed number of iterations have passed.

Parameters
^^^^^^^^^^
* :code:`numIter`: the number of simulation iterations to run.

Configuration file
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code:: yaml
  
  stop:
    Num. iter:
      numIter:
        type: int
        value: max_iter
diffusion-stop:Num. Iter.html:
The simulation stops when a fixed number of iterations have passed.

Parameters

  • numIter: the number of simulation iterations to run.

diffusion-stop:Total propagated.title: Total propagated
diffusion-stop:Total propagated.text:
The simulation stops when a fixed amount of pieces have been propagated.

Parameters
^^^^^^^^^^
* :code:`limit`: the number of pieces which need to be propagated.

Configuration file
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code:: yaml
  
  stop:
    Num. iter:
      limit:
        type: long
        value: num_pieces
diffusion-stop:Total propagated.html:
The simulation stops when a fixed amount of pieces have been propagated.

Parameters

  • limit: the number of pieces which need to be propagated.
